flags.message: While looking up the pre-application Fifth Circuit decision for docket No. 16-70010 via CourtListener's clusters endpoint on the docket IDs returned by a time-masked corpus query (ca5/4480565 and ca5/6240540), docket 6240540 returned cluster metadata (cluster_id 4450924) with date_filed '2017-12-12' alongside docket 4480565's pre-cutoff cluster (cluster_id 4313659, date_filed '2016-10-19'). We read only the 2016-10-19 opinion (opinion_id 4090920), did not read the 2017-12-12 opinion (opinion_id 4228177), and did not fold the existence of a December 2017 Fifth Circuit filing into our forecast.

record/context.json carries mode='forward' and decided_before=null on an OT2017 capital stay application (17A145, opened_at 2017-08-10, cutoff 2017-08-11) because the event remains resolved=false in the corpus. We enforced the 2017-08-11 date cutoff and Term 2017 replay clock on all corpus queries and statpack base-rate pooling.
